title: Each view hides the graphics of the systems listed in view[0-3].scene.hideMbs
author: Claude-JG
description: The views 0-3 of the render window show the same graphics; to show different things in different views, a list hideMbs of system numbers per view leaves out the graphics of those systems in that view: faces, edges, lines, texts and their shadows, the picking with the mouse, zoom all, the sensor traces and the raytracer of that view.
releaseNotes: view0.scene.hideMbs ... view3.scene.hideMbs: a list of system numbers whose graphics a view does not show - faces, edges, lines, texts, shadows, picking, the zoom of the view, the sensor traces of those systems and the raytracer image of the view; e.g. different systems in different views of one render window.
